description: Canonical Makefile target contract for every Concord member repo. A member's Makefile is the same file with a different jar name: these recipes are byte-identical across the suite once {modid} is substituted. This file is the machine-readable source of truth, enforced by scripts/check-makefile-targets.py (see `make makefile-check`). `universal` targets are required in every member. `conditional` targets are required only when the member's build.gradle wires the thing they drive, and are a note otherwise, so a member that genuinely has no datagen or no merged-coverage report is not reported as drift. The `help` strings are compared too: help is the one recipe that legitimately varies per member, since it lists only the targets that member has, so it is checked as an ordered projection of these descriptions rather than byte-for-byte. Deliberate per-repo additions beyond this set are notes, never drift — the contract is a floor, not a ceiling. Prose rules live in REPO-LAYOUT.md; edit both together.

universal.help: Compile, test, and assemble the mod jar
Print the path to the built primary jar
Launch a dev Minecraft client with the mod loaded
Launch a dev Minecraft server with the mod loaded
Generate Minecraft sources for IDE navigation
Print the base and git-derived computed version
recipe: @echo "computed: $$($(GRADLE) -q printVersion 2>/dev/null || echo '(gradle failed; falling back to base)')"

universal.help: Tag v<version> and push it to trigger the release (usage: make release VERSION=X.Y.Z [NO_PUSH=1])
recipe: @$(if $(NO_PUSH),echo "Tagged v$(VERSION) — push it with: git push origin v$(VERSION)",git push origin "v$(VERSION)")

universal.help: Build the website from site/ with the shared concord template
Build and serve the website locally with live reload

recipe: @test -d $(CONCORD_DIR)/.ai/skills || { echo "concord checkout not found at $(CONCORD_DIR) (set CONCORD_DIR=...)"; exit 1; }

conditional.help: Run unit tests + gametests and write the merged coverage report
recipe: @echo "note:   build/reports/jacoco/test/ is unit-tests-only — not the mod's coverage number"
conditional.because: a member that wires the merged report but omits the target undersells its real coverage number: the documented local entry point is missing while build/reports/jacoco/test/ (unit-only) is what a reader finds.
a member with a Loom datagen run config and no target leaves runDatagen discoverable only by reading build.gradle (mc-datagen, anchor 3).
